paragraphs.text: The Halquina islands is an archipelago in southwestern Terisiare , which were once a large mountainous region. One of these islands features Sarraza and the River Kingdom.
Halquina formed the southern province of Almaaz and contrasted with the more northerly province of Sumifa . Halquina was a mountainous region with an arid climate, though not without trees.
The songmage Samor was from Halquina.

The Halquina mountains lasted past the Brothers' War and through the Dark Age , but when the Ice Age started, they were buried under the Great Glacier . When the ice retreated after thousands year years, the mountains had been ground into the sea, and only some of the taller peaks remained as a set of islands south and west of the main island of Almaaz.
